selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the kernel hostname, hostnamectl static hostname, and /etc/hostname all equal os-lab.infra.test.
getent resolves os-lab.infra.test to 127.0.1.1 before and after reboot; the matching /etc/hosts entry is present.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db; the reboot scheduler acknowledged the request; post-restart boot ID changed to bb3e565d-2fd3-4620-bfd9-8e163b6da39c; system state returned to running with hostname and resolution intact.
